input.quote: This Agreement including all Exhibits, and the Non Disclosure Agreement and the Statement of Work referenced in this Agreement and incorporated by reference herein, constitutes the final, complete and exclusive agreement between the parties with respect to the subject matter hereof, and supersedes any prior or contemporaneous agreement.
input.rationale: Compliant by absence: the Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant, so nothing restricts Corio (our party) from soliciting, hiring or engaging Commerce One personnel. Searches for "solicit", "hire", "induce", "employ or engage" and "recruit" returned no results, and every personnel provision that does exist is neutral as to hiring: § 5 (training of Corio staff), § 13.1-13.3 (Commerce One provides Corio access to operations, consulting and engineering personnel), § 13.5 (Commerce One warranty that its staff sign Employee NDA/Invention Agreements), § 14.5 (independent contractors) and Exhibit D § 5 (each party assigns a sales/marketing contact). The playbook's preferred position is "No non-solicit on Customer," which the document already achieves, so no redline and no counterparty comment are warranted and all paragraphs are left unchanged. The residual deterministic checks for a 12-month duration and a general-solicitation carve-out cannot be satisfied here because there is no covenant to narrow; satisfying them would require inserting a restriction on our own client, which is contrary to the preferred position and to our client's interest. § 14.10 is cited solely as the scope anchor: it incorporates a separate Non-Disclosure Agreement and Statement of Work, and if either of those documents contains a non-solicit we would hold it to the fallback (mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the services, 12 months from the end of their involvement, carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches, and no no-hire).
